merchant/30891.htm.text: Trader Verona: Welcome, customer! Isn't Innadril a beautiful place? But know that its beauty can disguise its dangers. How can you appreciate a lovely sunset with a man-eating alligator moving towards you? Unless you have solid armor and a stout hammer, of course...

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30891-1.htm.text: Trader Verona: Huh? Would you like to trade?

merchant/30891-pk.htm.text: Trader Verona: Get out of here, scumbag! We don't serve the likes of you!
